    All Packages

    Package Summary
    Package
    Description
    library
    Java-Based Library Book Management System (Open-Ended Lab).
    library.exception
    Custom exceptions.
    library.model
    Model classes of the library: Book, Member, User, Loan, Transaction and the enums BookStatus, Category, Role and TransactionType.
    library.service
    Business logic and validation: LibraryService (books, loans, reservations, search, overdue, statistics), MemberService, AuthService (sign up / sign in / roles / hashing), TransactionService (history) and LibrarySystem, which wires them to the data store.
    library.storage
    Persistence: DataStore saves and loads users, books, members, loans and transactions as CSV files in the data/ folder using only java.nio.
    library.ui
    Swing user interface: LoginFrame / SignUpPanel, MainFrame, the role panels AdminPanel and StudentPanel with their pages, and reusable components such as UIStyle, StatCard, TableCard, SidebarPanel and SearchFilterBar.
